title: Prepare crystal structures for bulk and (111) slabs
action: Generate input files (crystal structure, k-point meshes, plane-wave cutoff, etc.) for bulk fcc Am and (111) slabs with 1 and 5 layers, using the experimental lattice constant of 9.26 a.u. Use the antiferromagnetic (AFM) configuration and the GGA-PBE exchange-correlation functional with spin-orbit coupling (SO).
description: This step creates the complete input decks required for the subsequent SCF calculations. No scored artifact is produced.

title: Run self-consistent field DFT calculations
action: Perform self-consistent field (SCF) calculations for the bulk, 1-layer, and 5-layer systems using the FP-LAPW method at the GGA-AFM-SO level. Converge the charge density to high precision (e.g., 0.01 mRy/atom).
description: The converged charge densities and Kohn-Sham eigenvalues are essential intermediates for DOS post-processing.

title: Compute and report 5f DOS peak positions
action: Use the SCF results to calculate the partial density of states for Am 5f electrons. Identify the energy of the first prominent peak below the Fermi level (EF set to zero) for each system. Write the three binding energies (negative eV) to the output JSON file.
description: Scored artifact: binding energies of the first 5f DOS peak below EF for bulk fcc Am, 1-layer (111) slab, and 5-layer (111) slab. The checker will verify the relative ordering and plausible range.
output_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"bulk": {"type": "number", "description": "Energy (eV) of first 5f peak below EF for bulk fcc Am"}, "film_1layer": {"type": "number", "description": "Energy (eV) of first 5f peak below EF for 1-layer (111) slab"}, "film_5layer": {"type": "number", "description": "Energy (eV) of first 5f peak below EF for 5-layer (111) slab"}}, "required": ["bulk", "film_1layer", "film_5layer"]}
